method: 70 further footprints of the county 'Structures' layer whose centroids lie inside the county's TA-53 boundary, used verbatim as one MultiPolygon; the six buildings drawn on their own records are excluded, and guard stations are left out. Their DESC_ values include 'Proton Storage Ring Stage', 'Proton Storage-Ring Equip', 'Isotope Production Facili', 'High Resolution Beam Facility', 'WNR Target Cell 4', 'Service Corridor', 'Accelerator Tech Bldg', cooling towers and storage buildings.
